cases.name: Kathleen Marie Flynn
cases.about: She had turned 11 just nine days earlier. Kathleen loved crafts and drawing, and her collection of Strawberry Shortcake dolls.
cases.caseStatus: CODIS / DNA MATCH; COLD CASE SOLVED; PENDING
cases.narrative: On 9/24/1986, her body was found in a thick swath of woods between a path she walked home and her Ponus Ridge Middle School athletic fields. Officers found her half-nude body under a pile of brush and tree limbs. A ligature strangulation mark was easily visible on her neck along with three to four rows of ligature bindings on both wrists. The ligatures used by the perpetrator to strangle her and bind her wrists had been removed by the perpetrator before he concealed her body. Her body showed signs of sexual assault based on extensive vaginal bleeding in the front and on her buttocks. An autopsy confirmed ligature furrows on Ms. Flynn's neck and her wrists, as well as multiple vaginal lacerations.
